d:
Enjoy the beautiful romantic song “Yeh Jo Teri Payalon Ki Chan Chan Hai” from the movie Masoom, featuring Abhijeet Bhattacharya and Sadhana Sargam. This Insta Mix brings back the magic of 90s Bollywood romance with its melodious music and timeless charm.
Song Credits:
Singer(s): Abhijeet Bhattacharya, Sadhana Sargam
Music Director: Anand Raj Anand
Lyricist: Anand Raj Anand
Movie Cast & Crew:
Producer: Sanjay Bali, Lokesh Bali
Director: Mahesh Kothare
